def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Trim and standardize island labels
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric, treat non-numeric as NaN and drop those rows
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, treat non-numeric as NaN and drop those rows
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    # Enforce valid ranges (as per rules)
    df = df[(df['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (df['bill_length_mm'] <= 60)]
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Filter for Adelie penguins
    sub = df[df['species'] == 'Adelie']
    # Group by island and compute average bill length
    result = sub.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
